notes: Officials: Sanitary Officer Unit-09 and Unit-11 are both printed with 9445025837 (p.312); the relief-centre tables list the U-11 Sanitary Inspector as 9445190684 and U-10 as 9445025836, so the Unit-11 entry may be a copy error in the source. Kept as printed.
Chairman row (p.311) has no phone number printed.
NDRF Commandant phone printed as '04177 – 246594/246269'; the second number is recorded with the shared 04177 prefix.

inundation_streets = 'Water stagnated streets in the previous monsoon - heavy rain' table (pp.320-322, 31 rows); the table has no depth/days-to-drain columns. Pump/location/disposal cells are merged across rows 1-3, 4-5, 13-21 and 24-25 and were copied to each row. Rows 6-12 and 26 carry a 'Canal Overflow ... not feasible of pump usage' note across the pump columns, stored in disposal_point.

Sewer-block stagnation table (pp.328-329) also gives 'No. of manholes' per street, not captured by the schema. Rows 57-58 repeat rows 55-56 (Sikkinder Palayam, Bharathi Nagar, ward 47) in the source; kept as printed.

Relief centres: the text says 18 centres / capacity 12,600 but the detailed table (pp.330-332) has only rows 1-11. R12-R18 come only from the map legend on p.333 (name and ward only; facilities, capacity and contacts not given). Their streets_to_shift come from legend rows S12-S18, paired by ID number (S-row wards match R-row wards for all 18 IDs); treat this pairing as inferred.
Relief-centre facility columns are ordered Drinking water | Toilets | Cooking facilities in the PDF (verified on the page image); every table row reads Yes | Yes | NO, i.e. cooking = false.

Relief-centre contact designations carry the 'Responsibilities' column in brackets (and the unit, e.g. U-9, printed in the Sanitary Inspector's contact cell). Identical officer+numbers for two responsibilities are merged. Centre 1's relief-materials officer is printed as 'Assistant Revenue' (truncated).
Relief centres 9 and 10 (ward 39) have no capacity printed. Centre 4 (ward 48) lists streets as 'Nil' while the map legend S4 lists 'Parthasarathy Nagar'.

Evacuation table (pp.337-339): 'No. of persons' cells are merged across several streets (S.No 2-3 = 3670, 4-10 = 200, 11-19 = 1500, 29-33 = 5000); stored as a string on each row of the group to avoid double counting. Relief-centre cells are likewise merged and copied to each row.
Water-entered-houses table (pp.335-336) is numbered 1-20 with S.No 18 used twice (21 rows) and 'Ambedkar Street, ward 47' appears twice; text says 19 locations. All printed rows kept.
Boats (p.342): 'location' is the 'Boats stationed Locations' column; the required-boats column and the contact (AE/JE mobile) are in details.
No zonal office address, hospital/UPHC list, police or fire contacts are given in this zone's appendix.
Pumping stations (pp.314-315): ward not given; text says 34 stations with average capacity 9.30 MLD.
